_doc: Verdicts for the 150 claims of sample-F.claims.json (seed 20261024, drawn from the DATA build after the artillery, positions and rejoin work (tmp/data-audit/data-R1c, release id 2a2fcf9d at the draw). v: C correct (for an estimate: inside the range the sources allow), I incorrect or unsupported, L labelled (a Contested or modelled note is on the claim), U cannot be checked against the sources read (excluded). Evidence for a claim judged C without its own line is the source class named for its category; the evidence of every error, label and unverifiable claim is given. The errors were corrected after the draw (artillery organisation, fates of commanders, CS-005, Carrington's position, tour stop 1); a further sweep of each class followed (AUDIT.md section 4).
